prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen, layout), sign_in (hint, reorder), and choose_path (copy, layout) changes, as each kind of change has only 1 test so far.
home new_flow changes have 2 tests agreeing on positive noise-corrected gains (+4.6% and +1.2%); since one test won, this kind of change can be helpful.
No clear effect was seen for most changes tested so far (7 out of 8 tests).
Predictions were generally too high, overestimating impact in almost all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -2.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.9% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +0.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 87.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout companion selection redesign: Redesign pet selection into a clear grid layout with structured choice cards to prevent custom pet creation errors. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (60.9% conversion) and support reported issues with custom pet generation failing.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop control walkthrough step: Add a post-setup screen demonstrating right-click controls to show users how to hide, move, and interact with their pet. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion post-onboarding about controlling, hiding, or talking to the desktop pet.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move account sign-in after pet customization: Move sign-in after pet picking and photo upload screens so users build attachment before being asked to sign in. (why: Sign-in currently has a 72.9% conversion rate early in the flow before users have crafted their pet.)
3: [home, new_flow] Setup status checklist during generation: Replace the static waiting screen with an active checklist flow showing desktop asset generation progress. (why: Home waiting step has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Path processing time hint: Add a clear hint comparing fast adoption vs custom creation build times on the choose path screen. (why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s), indicating hesitation when selecting between paths.)
5: [home, wait_info] Estimated wait time display: Show estimated processing time and active tips while pet assets load on the waiting screen. (why: Median wait time is 201s, leaving users wondering how long desktop creation will take.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Cloud account protection notice: Display an explicit cloud save notification on sign-in clarifying that logging in prevents pet data loss. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) is pets going missing or resetting after signing back in.)
7: [adoption, layout] Stage layout for adoption certificate: Change the adoption certificate screen to stage layout to emphasize pet completion. (why: Adoption stage has high drop-off (60.9%), needing a more rewarding experience.)
8: [finish, copy] Desktop discovery guide copy: Update home_intro text with clear instructions on where on screen the pet appears upon finishing. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing up on desktop or confusion finding app window.)
9: [choose_path, layout] Carousel story onboarding layout: Switch story screen to carousel layout to introduce desktop pet capabilities dynamically. (why: 76.2% conversion on initial path choice can be boosted by building stronger product value upfront.)
